title: Registering the while Keywords
description: Three new entries in the KEYWORDS map in lexer.py, so the lexer recognizes while, do, and done as keywords instead of identifiers.

steps.description: This adds `while`, `do`, and `done` to the `KEYWORDS` map in `lexer.py`. The page says to register them as keywords, so the lexer turns those words into tokens rather than identifiers.
`KEYWORDS` is the dictionary the lexer checks. The comment marks where the existing keywords already sit.
Each line maps a word to a token type: `while` to `WHILE`, `do` to `DO`, and `done` to `DONE`.
